Graduate Programs
Graduate Programs
The Graduate Programs in Biomedical and Molecular Sciences offer:
a thesis-based MSc research degree
a thesis-based PhD degree
an MSc (Anatomical Sciences)
a combined BScH/MSc program
a combined MD/PhD and a combined MD/Master program
a graduate diploma in Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Management and Innovation
APPLY NOW
Learn more about how to apply to our graduate programs
In the MSc and PhD degree programs, students choose one of the following Fields of Specialization, which represent the current research strengths of the Department.
Biochemistry and Cell Biology
Experimental Medicine
Microbes, Immunity, and Inflammation
Reproduction and Developmental Sciences
Therapeutics, Drug Development, and Human Toxicology
DBMS also offers a joint MSc program in Biomedical Informatics in partnership with the School of Queen’s Computing
Master’s in Biomedical Informatics (MBI)
Please visit the program website for more information and application details
